set.approach: From the Ferry Hill historic site, follow the Ferry Hill trail along the canal upstream until the cliff appears on your right; the same trail leads to the top of the climb. The route starts on the crack where a stone was removed and climbs toward the tree above the crack, staying left of the roof.

review.notes: Route page location and protection lines; area page for the canal walk. Lead review dropped the descent: it described reaching the top anchor, not getting down.

set.approach: Start from the climbers' parking at Carderock, descend to Hades Heights, and cross the river onto Vaso Island. Bushwhack almost straight across the island to the opposite shore to find the crag. The route starts from a ledge on the northern face by a tree.

review.notes: Both pages. Bolted anchors on top; no descent stated.

Start from the climbers' parking at Carderock, descend to Hades Heights, and cross the river onto Vaso Island. Bushwhack almost straight across the island to the opposite shore to find the crag. The route is on the riverside face, following a dark streak up the slab; belay from a small ledge at its base or from a large boulder a little way back.

review.notes: Route page protection line for anchor access; area page for approach. Lead review dropped the descent: it described reaching the top anchor, not getting down.
